publisher: Devon County Council Historic Environment Record
evidence_slice: Devon County Council's official public no-login Historic Environment ArcGIS service exposes layer 10, 'Local List (Register of Heritage Assets)', as an esriGeometryPolygon Feature Layer with query capability and OBJECTID, DesigUID, ListEntry and Name fields. The layer description states that the dataset is maintained by Devon County Council HER from Local Planning Authority submissions and states that Mid Devon was the only LPA to have compiled a list at the time of writing. A distinct Exeter EPSG:27700 envelope window 288000,88000,298000,99000 with resultRecordCount=50 and returnGeometry=true was attempted. The exact query payload was not retrievable through the web channel, and direct network access failed at DNS resolution, so no Exeter feature payload, footprint polygon, or record-bound type/use evidence was available. No geometry or record was inferred or fabricated.

field_evidence.footprint: Official layer metadata declares esriGeometryPolygon and query capability, but the selected Exeter bbox feature payload was not retrievable; no polygon coordinates were read.
field_evidence.type_use: Official layer schema exposes Name and ListEntry fields intended to bind identity to each Local List polygon, but no Exeter feature payload was retrieved.
field_evidence.source_area: Official DCC HER layer-10 service metadata was read; source-area/service metadata only and no parcel-progress credit.
